column1: # Unit 4 — Time & dates
w102|今天|jīntiān|today|今天星期几？|Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ?|What day is it today?
w103|明天|míngtiān|tomorrow|明天是星期天。|Míngtiān shì xīngqītiān.|Tomorrow is Sunday.
w104|昨天|zuótiān|yesterday|昨天我很忙。|Zuótiān wǒ hěn máng.|I was very busy yesterday.
w105|今年|jīnnián|this year|我今年三十岁。|Wǒ jīnnián sānshí suì.|I'm thirty this year.
w106|明年|míngnián|next year|明年我想去中国。|Míngnián wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó.|Next year I want to go to China.
w107|去年|qùnián|last year|去年我在北京。|Qùnián wǒ zài Běijīng.|Last year I was in Beijing.
w108|年|nián|year|一年有十二个月。|Yì nián yǒu shí'èr ge yuè.|A year has twelve months.
w109|月|yuè|month; moon|现在是十月。|Xiànzài shì shí yuè.|It's October now.
w110|日|rì|day; date (written)|今天是十月一日。|Jīntiān shì shí yuè yī rì.|Today is October 1st.
w111|号|hào|date; number|你的生日是几号？|Nǐ de shēngrì shì jǐ hào?|What date is your birthday?
w112|天|tiān|day; sky|我去了三天。|Wǒ qù le sān tiān.|I went for three days.
w113|星期|xīngqī|week|这个星期我很忙。|Zhège xīngqī wǒ hěn máng.|I'm very busy this week.
w114|星期天|xīngqītiān|Sunday|星期天我休息。|Xīngqītiān wǒ xiūxi.|I rest on Sunday.
w115|星期日|xīngqīrì|Sunday (formal)|星期日商店开门吗？|Xīngqīrì shāngdiàn kāi mén ma?|Is the store open on Sunday?
w116|现在|xiànzài|now|现在几点？|Xiànzài jǐ diǎn?|What time is it now?
w117|点|diǎn|o'clock; point|我七点起床。|Wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng.|I get up at seven.
w118|分|fēn|minute; cent; to divide|现在八点十分。|Xiànzài bā diǎn shí fēn.|It's 8:10 now.
w119|分钟|fēnzhōng|minute (duration)|请等五分钟。|Qǐng děng wǔ fēnzhōng.|Please wait five minutes.
w120|小时|xiǎoshí|hour|我每天学习一个小时。|Wǒ měi tiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí.|I study one hour every day.
w121|时候|shíhou|time; moment|你什么时候来？|Nǐ shénme shíhou lái?|When are you coming?
w122|时间|shíjiān|time|你有时间吗？|Nǐ yǒu shíjiān ma?|Do you have time?
w123|早上|zǎoshang|early morning|早上好！|Zǎoshang hǎo!|Good morning!
w124|上午|shàngwǔ|morning (before noon)|我上午工作。|Wǒ shàngwǔ gōngzuò.|I work in the morning.
w125|中午|zhōngwǔ|noon|中午我们吃饺子。|Zhōngwǔ wǒmen chī jiǎozi.|We'll eat dumplings at noon.
w126|下午|xiàwǔ|afternoon|下午我去商店。|Xiàwǔ wǒ qù shāngdiàn.|I'm going to the store this afternoon.
w127|晚上|wǎnshang|evening|晚上我看电视。|Wǎnshang wǒ kàn diànshì.|I watch TV in the evening.
w128|白天|báitiān|daytime|白天我很忙。|Báitiān wǒ hěn máng.|I'm busy during the day.
w129|早|zǎo|early; good morning|你来得很早。|Nǐ lái de hěn zǎo.|You came very early.
w130|晚|wǎn|late|太晚了，我要睡觉了。|Tài wǎn le, wǒ yào shuìjiào le.|It's late — I'm going to bed.
w131|前|qián|front; before|学校前边有一个商店。|Xuéxiào qiánbian yǒu yí ge shāngdiàn.|There's a store in front of the school.
w132|后|hòu|back; after|下课后我回家。|Xià kè hòu wǒ huí jiā.|I go home after class.
# Unit 5 — Food & drink
w133|吃|chī|to eat|你想吃什么？|Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?|What do you want to eat?
w134|喝|hē|to drink|我想喝茶。|Wǒ xiǎng hē chá.|I want to drink tea.
w135|饭|fàn|meal; cooked rice|你吃饭了吗？|Nǐ chī fàn le ma?|Have you eaten?
w136|米饭|mǐfàn|cooked rice|我要一碗米饭。|Wǒ yào yì wǎn mǐfàn.|I'd like a bowl of rice.
w137|早饭|zǎofàn|breakfast|你吃早饭了吗？|Nǐ chī zǎofàn le ma?|Have you had breakfast?
w138|午饭|wǔfàn|lunch|我们一起吃午饭吧。|Wǒmen yìqǐ chī wǔfàn ba.|Let's have lunch together.
w139|晚饭|wǎnfàn|dinner|晚饭吃什么？|Wǎnfàn chī shénme?|What's for dinner?
w140|做饭|zuò fàn|to cook|妈妈在做饭。|Māma zài zuò fàn.|Mom is cooking.
w141|菜|cài|dish; vegetable|这个菜很好吃。|Zhège cài hěn hǎochī.|This dish is delicious.
w142|茶|chá|tea|中国人喜欢喝茶。|Zhōngguó rén xǐhuan hē chá.|Chinese people like drinking tea.
w143|水|shuǐ|water|我想喝水。|Wǒ xiǎng hē shuǐ.|I want to drink water.
w144|牛奶|niúnǎi|milk|我早上喝牛奶。|Wǒ zǎoshang hē niúnǎi.|I drink milk in the morning.
w145|杯子|bēizi|cup; glass|这是我的杯子。|Zhè shì wǒ de bēizi.|This is my cup.
w146|苹果|píngguǒ|apple|我喜欢吃苹果。|Wǒ xǐhuan chī píngguǒ.|I like eating apples.
w147|水果|shuǐguǒ|fruit|你喜欢吃什么水果？|Nǐ xǐhuan chī shénme shuǐguǒ?|What fruit do you like?
w148|鸡蛋|jīdàn|egg|我早饭吃鸡蛋。|Wǒ zǎofàn chī jīdàn.|I eat eggs for breakfast.
w149|面包|miànbāo|bread|我想买面包。|Wǒ xiǎng mǎi miànbāo.|I want to buy bread.
w150|面条儿|miàntiáor|noodles|中午我吃面条儿。|Zhōngwǔ wǒ chī miàntiáor.|I eat noodles at noon.
w151|饺子|jiǎozi|dumplings|我很喜欢吃饺子。|Wǒ hěn xǐhuan chī jiǎozi.|I really like dumplings.
w152|包子|bāozi|steamed bun|这个包子很好吃。|Zhège bāozi hěn hǎochī.|This bun is delicious.
w153|好吃|hǎochī|delicious|饺子很好吃！|Jiǎozi hěn hǎochī!|Dumplings are delicious!
w154|饭店|fàndiàn|restaurant; hotel|我们去饭店吃饭吧。|Wǒmen qù fàndiàn chī fàn ba.|Let's go eat at a restaurant.
# Unit 6 — Core verbs
w155|有|yǒu|to have; there is|我有一个妹妹。|Wǒ yǒu yí ge mèimei.|I have a younger sister.
w156|没有|méiyǒu|not have; there isn't|我没有时间。|Wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān.|I don't have time.
w157|在|zài|at; in; to be at|我在家。|Wǒ zài jiā.|I'm at home.
w158|去|qù|to go|我们去吃饭吧！|Wǒmen qù chī fàn ba!|Let's go eat!
w159|来|lái|to come|你来我家吧！|Nǐ lái wǒ jiā ba!|Come over to my place!
w160|回|huí|to return|我想回家。|Wǒ xiǎng huí jiā.|I want to go home.
w161|到|dào|to arrive; to|我到了！|Wǒ dào le!|I've arrived!
w162|看|kàn|to look; to watch; to read|我在看书。|Wǒ zài kàn shū.|I'm reading a book.
w163|看见|kànjiàn|to see|你看见我的手机了吗？|Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de shǒujī le ma?|Did you see my phone?
w164|听|tīng|to listen|我喜欢听歌。|Wǒ xǐhuan tīng gē.|I like listening to songs.
w165|听见|tīngjiàn|to hear|我听见了。|Wǒ tīngjiàn le.|I heard it.
w166|说|shuō|to speak; to say|请再说一次。|Qǐng zài shuō yí cì.|Please say it again.
w167|说话|shuō huà|to talk|他不喜欢说话。|Tā bù xǐhuan shuō huà.|He doesn't like to talk.
w168|见|jiàn|to see; to meet|明天见！|Míngtiān jiàn!|See you tomorrow!
w169|做|zuò|to do; to make|你在做什么？|Nǐ zài zuò shénme?|What are you doing?
w170|想|xiǎng|to want; to think; to miss|我想你。|Wǒ xiǎng nǐ.|I miss you.
w171|要|yào|to want; will; need|我要一杯茶。|Wǒ yào yì bēi chá.|I'd like a cup of tea.
w172|不要|búyào|don't; not want|不要说话。|Búyào shuō huà.|Don't talk.
w173|喜欢|xǐhuan|to like|我喜欢喝茶。|Wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.|I like drinking tea.
w174|爱|ài|to love|我爱我的家。|Wǒ ài wǒ de jiā.|I love my family.
w175|会|huì|can (learned skill); will|我会说汉语。|Wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ.|I can speak Chinese.
w176|能|néng|can; be able to|你能来吗？|Nǐ néng lái ma?|Can you come?
w177|可以|kěyǐ|may; can|我可以坐这儿吗？|Wǒ kěyǐ zuò zhèr ma?|May I sit here?
w178|知道|zhīdào|to know (a fact)|我不知道。|Wǒ bù zhīdào.|I don't know.
w179|觉得|juéde|to feel; to think|我觉得很好。|Wǒ juéde hěn hǎo.|I think it's good.
w180|买|mǎi|to buy|我想买一件衣服。|Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn yīfu.|I want to buy a piece of clothing.
w181|卖|mài|to sell|这个商店卖水果。|Zhège shāngdiàn mài shuǐguǒ.|This store sells fruit.
w182|给|gěi|to give; for|请给我一杯水。|Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ.|Please give me a glass of water.
w183|找|zhǎo|to look for|我在找我的手机。|Wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de shǒujī.|I'm looking for my phone.
w184|问|wèn|to ask|我可以问你一个问题吗？|Wǒ kěyǐ wèn nǐ yí ge wèntí ma?|Can I ask you a question?
w185|问题|wèntí|question; problem|没问题！|Méi wèntí!|No problem!
w186|住|zhù|to live; to stay|你住在哪儿？|Nǐ zhù zài nǎr?|Where do you live?
w187|坐|zuò|to sit; to take (transport)|我坐出租车去。|Wǒ zuò chūzūchē qù.|I'll take a taxi.
w188|开|kāi|to open; to drive|请开门。|Qǐng kāi mén.|Please open the door.
w189|开车|kāi chē|to drive|我会开车。|Wǒ huì kāi chē.|I can drive.
w190|穿|chuān|to wear|今天穿什么？|Jīntiān chuān shénme?|What should I wear today?
w191|玩|wán|to play; to have fun|周末我们去玩。|Zhōumò wǒmen qù wán.|We'll go have fun on the weekend.
w192|唱|chàng|to sing|她很会唱歌。|Tā hěn huì chàng gē.|She sings really well.
w193|歌|gē|song|她喜欢唱歌。|Tā xǐhuan chàng gē.|She likes singing.
w194|写|xiě|to write|我会写汉字。|Wǒ huì xiě Hànzì.|I can write Chinese characters.
w195|读|dú|to read (aloud)|请读一下。|Qǐng dú yíxià.|Please read it aloud.
w196|读书|dú shū|to read; to study|他在读书。|Tā zài dú shū.|He's reading.
w197|学|xué|to learn|我在学汉语。|Wǒ zài xué Hànyǔ.|I'm learning Chinese.
w198|学习|xuéxí|to study|我每天学习汉语。|Wǒ měi tiān xuéxí Hànyǔ.|I study Chinese every day.
w199|睡|shuì|to sleep|他还在睡。|Tā hái zài shuì.|He's still sleeping.
w200|睡觉|shuì jiào|to go to bed; sleep|我十一点睡觉。|Wǒ shíyī diǎn shuì jiào.|I go to bed at eleven.
w201|起床|qǐ chuáng|to get up|你几点起床？|Nǐ jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?|What time do you get up?
w202|休息|xiūxi|to rest|你休息一下吧。|Nǐ xiūxi yíxià ba.|Take a rest.
w203|工作|gōngzuò|to work; job|你做什么工作？|Nǐ zuò shénme gōngzuò?|What do you do for work?
w204|打电话|dǎ diànhuà|to make a phone call|我给妈妈打电话。|Wǒ gěi māma dǎ diànhuà.|I'm calling mom.
# Unit 6b — Daily routine
w205|上班|shàng bān|to go to work|我八点上班。|Wǒ bā diǎn shàng bān.|I start work at eight.
w206|下班|xià bān|to get off work|你几点下班？|Nǐ jǐ diǎn xià bān?|What time do you get off work?
w207|上学|shàng xué|to go to school|弟弟七点去上学。|Dìdi qī diǎn qù shàng xué.|My younger brother goes to school at seven.
w208|上课|shàng kè|to attend class|我们九点上课。|Wǒmen jiǔ diǎn shàng kè.|Class starts at nine.
w209|下课|xià kè|class is over|下课了！|Xià kè le!|Class is over!
